tests_first.reason: Honest missing ExpansionLimits/with_limits compile failure; owned cleanup passed. All seven budget cases were written before production implementation. No manufactured runtime-red or placeholder budget algorithm.

policy: Validated limits: default depth 8 / requests 64 / steps 1500 / links 6000 / unique source bytes 16 MiB; ceilings 32/128/1500/6000/16 MiB. Depth/requests zero allowed; other allowances positive.
Selection-envelope caps remain independent of execution allowances.

One assembler proves all-stopped mandatory-root fit, then performs bounded private attempts. A typed failure demotes its active selected child, or latest successful root graft for later caller work. The demotion set grows, but graph size need not shrink. No promise to maximize the expanded subset.
At most selections plus one actual attempt; malformed input, cancellation, mandatory-root failures and failures without a new eligible demotion propagate errors.
Source text stays borrowed throughout attempts and materializes only after a complete success. Existing owners charge once; admission checks before mutation.
Reached selection evaluations are charged even inside rejected staging; blocked descendants are not evaluated; counters reset between attempts.
coverage: Exact step/link allowances and independent one-under failures
Late caller suffix and duplicated finally cleanup overflow
Always-throwing B demotion restores a larger suffix, forcing later A demotion; deterministic input/selection permutation
Shared source owner; oversized borrowed child yields SourceBytes stop plus blocked descendant; oversized root errors
Rejected nested staging does not refund reached-request work
Zero depth/requests; invalid ceilings/positive minima; mandatory-root exhaustion; entry cancellation
maintainability: Private typed BudgetExceeded carried through anyhow downcasting; separate preparation, single-attempt assembly, materialization and bounded retry. Prepared immutable inputs/indexes reused via synchronous Rc/RefCell. Invalid-limit input fixtures separated from test assertions. No string error matching or graph/source-text cloning.
